versions.localizedDescription:
## What's Changed
* fix(sync): one row over a limit no longer stops every sync by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1168
* fix(app): keep open pages when the lock screen comes and goes by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1172
* fix(library): the extension filter offers every extension again by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1173
* fix(linux): a failed Discord connection no longer crashes the app by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1175
* fix(sync-server): `pair` opens pairing again by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1177
* fix(desktop): the window no longer comes back fullscreen by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1178
* fix(reader): the next page is ready before it is turned to by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1185
* fix(linux): the reader no longer freezes the app opening under Wayland by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1186
* perf: no blocking file access on the UI thread, and "Reduce Motion" support by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1189
* feat: show which chapters are missing, and warn before skipping them by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1190
* fix: pages no longer run under the system's navigation bar by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1191
* fix: extensions of a removed repository no longer stay listed by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1192
* l10n: translate the strings left untranslated by @kodjodevf in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/1194


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/compare/v0.9.96...v0.9.97
